items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
),
 last_week AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(tw.traffic_source, lw.traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
  COALESCE(tw.sessions,0) AS sessions_this_week,
  COALESCE(lw.sessions,0) AS sessions_last_week,
  COALESCE(tw.sessions,0) - COALESCE(lw.sessions,0) AS diff
FROM this_week tw
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week lw USING (traffic_source)
ORDER BY sessions_this_week DESC;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql: SELECT traffic_source, traffic_medium, SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(sessions) AS sessions, ROUND((SUM(conversions)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions),0) * 100), 2) AS conversion_rate FROM agg_traffic_hourly WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100 ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT session_id, device_type, event_name
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= current_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND timestamp < current_date
), total_sessions AS (
  SELECT device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
  FROM recent
  GROUP BY device_type
), payment_sessions AS (
  SELECT device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS paid_sessions
  FROM recent
  WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
  GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT t.device_type,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(p.paid_sessions, 0) / NULLIF(t.sessions,0), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM total_sessions t
LEFT JOIN payment_sessions p USING (device_type)
ORDER BY t.device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT summary_date, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS uniq
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
 SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS this_count
 FROM agg_event_daily
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
   AND summary_date <= current_date
 GROUP BY event_name
),
 last_week AS (
 SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS last_count
 FROM agg_event_daily
 WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
 GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.event_name, l.event_name) AS event_name,
       COALESCE(t.this_count,0) AS this_week_count,
       COALESCE(l.last_count,0) AS last_week_count,
       COALESCE(t.this_count,0)-COALESCE(l.last_count,0) AS change
FROM this_week t
FULL JOIN last_week l USING(event_name)
ORDER BY change DESC
LIMIT 20;

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH last_week_vis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_id
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
),
vis_first_dates AS (
  SELECT lv.client_id, MIN(au.summary_date) AS first_date
  FROM last_week_vis lv
  JOIN agg_daily_users au ON lv.client_id = au.client_id
  GROUP BY lv.client_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days'
           AND first_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_visitors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_visitors
FROM vis_first_dates;

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date <= current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM summary_date) IN (0,6) THEN sessions END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM summary_date) IN (0,6) THEN 1 END),0) AS weekend_avg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM summary_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN sessions END)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM summary_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1 END),0) AS weekday_avg
FROM daily_sessions;

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month')::date
           AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
        THEN 'last_month'
        WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
           AND summary_date < current_date
        THEN 'this_month'
    END AS period,
    SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
    COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date) AS days
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE (summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month')::date
          AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date)
     OR (summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
          AND summary_date < current_date)
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT period,
       total_page_views,
       days,
       total_page_views::numeric / NULLIF(days,0) AS avg_daily_page_views
FROM monthly;
